title: AI Mentor for NSE Swing Traders
author: DrawingBrief9737
selftext:
Hello everyone,

I’ve been working on building intelligent systems, and one of the products I’m currently developing is an AI companion for retail traders.

The idea is not to build something that trades for you. Instead, I want it to act more like a mentor, helping traders think through setups, make better informed decisions, and improve their trading process over time.

Why am I posting here?    
I’m looking to connect with serious NSE swing traders. I’d love to understand how you currently trade, the problems you regularly face, and where a product like this could genuinely be useful.    
I’m not sure if this is the right platform to ask, but I’d really appreciate any advice on how I can connect with the right traders or feedback from anyone interested in helping shape the product.

You can try the current version here:    
dev.zorex.app

Would love to hear your thoughts.
